description: Academic paper metadata from 57M+ works — title, abstract, authors, citations, DOI and open access URL. Covers every field: CS, medicine, physics, economics, biology, and more. Search by keywords (e.g. "transformer attention"), by topic name (e.g. "machine learning"), or by OpenAlex topic ID. Returns papers sorted by citation count. Source: OpenAlex (CC0 metadata). Use this when the user needs scholarly references, citation counts, or research context that Wikipedia does not cover.

query.description: Keywords to search for. Matches topic names to find the right research area, then filters by title and abstract. Example: "transformer attention", "CRISPR gene editing".

topic.description: Topic name or OpenAlex topic ID. Names are resolved automatically (e.g. "machine learning" → T10135). Use an ID like "T10135" if you already know it. Optional — query alone works.

year.description: Publication year to filter on, e.g. 2023.

name: papers
